claim: A protein representation model pretrained with generator-corrupted cross-view recovery maintains competitive performance on Enzyme Commission (EC) and Gene Ontology (GO) benchmarks while improving structure prediction tasks, indicating that structural awareness does not degrade broad biological representation quality.
falsifier: Train a protein representation model with generator-corrupted cross-view recovery and evaluate on EC/GO benchmarks; compare performance to state-of-the-art models.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, tasks, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.
